label: Ilias (Greek) / Homer, VGF 64

metadata.label: Content
metadata.value: Contains: (ff. 1r-493v) Iliad / Homer. Incomplete (most of book 24 misses). With interlinear glosses, excerpts from the commentary of Eustathius, scholia (partly excerpts of the commentary of Porphyrius) and marginal notes by Isaac Vossius.

metadata.label: Note
value: At the beginning and end of the codex, leaves are damaged with consequent loss of text.
